checkpoint_rule: Each model minimizes inner-validation LogLoss with the same training budget. All models freeze before outer validation is loaded. No best-seed selection.
feature_contract: Use the audited implementation schema: context=cat0,cat1,num16..num50; ad=cat2..cat12; full=all 48. These are observed invariance roles, not recovered semantic meanings. Exclude IDs, logged rank, labels, displayrandom, protected_attribute and senior.
ranking_contract: Only impressions with >=2 candidates and both clicked/nonclicked ads. Primary NDCG@5 averages over all permutations within exact score ties, without product IDs. Pair accuracy averages within-impression positive-negative concordance, ties=0.5, then equally averages impressions. Also report legacy product-ID tie breaking, random baseline and randomized-display subgroup.
uncertainty: Paired user-cluster bootstrap, retaining impression/row multiplicity. Primary estimates average paired metric differences over all three seeds before user resampling; also show fixed representative seed 42. Intervals condition on these trained models, not training resamples.
diagnostics: Measure score spans on all multi-candidate impressions. Average each full-model impression's predictions into a common score as a label-free diagnostic; this is not a deployable context-only trained model. Report ad-only controls and raw/transformed candidate feature collisions.
examples: Seed 42, outer eligible impressions with 3..8 candidates, nonzero full score span. Show largest positive and largest negative tie-averaged NDCG change vs context, ties by impression ID. Label selected extremes as illustrative, never representative.
test_policy: Do not read original test. This is a prespecified follow-up analysis of already-used development data, not a fresh independent holdout or causal/online CTR experiment.
deployment_policy: Diagnostic models only. Do not change the existing champion, serving configuration or registry aliases.
